input_directory.description: The directory where the source files for the static site are located.

output_directory.description: The directory where the generated static site files will be saved.

passthorugh_files.description: A list of file patterns to be copied directly from the input directory to the output directory without processing.

default_template.description: The default template file to be used for generating pages if no specific template is provided.

site_title.description: The title of the static site, which can be used in templates and metadata.

site_description.description: A brief description of the static site, which can be used in templates and metadata.

site_author.description: The author of the static site, which can be used in templates and metadata.

Plugins.description: A list of plugins to be used during the static site generation process.
